name: @ship/home
description: Ship Home pack — <ship-home-greeting>, <ship-spaces-hero>, <ship-activity-runs>. The hub `/` dashboard composite; composes <sui-card> / <sui-avatar> / <sui-status-dot> / <sui-empty-state> / <sui-stack> / <sui-badge> from @ship/sui-primitives. The greeting and spaces-hero are pure-derived presenters; ship-activity-runs reads the Connect SDK (ship.pipelines.summaries). Spaces-list is a known BACKEND-GAP; <ship-spaces-hero> degrades to the empty-state until a list-all-spaces SDK method lands.
